## Local development and deployment

Local: two processes (backend :8000, frontend :3000 — see Quickstart). Without env
vars the backend still starts the keyless in-memory demo.

- **Frontend → Vercel**: project with root directory `web/`, env `BACKEND_URL` set to
  the backend URL, optional `APP_TIME_ZONE`. Hobby plan is free for personal use.
- **Backend → any long-running host** (it is a Python service — Vercel serverless
  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |
  Env vars: `DATABASE_URL`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`OR_API_KEY`/`ZAI_API_KEY`,
  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).
- **Gmail token on a deployed backend**: run `scripts/auth_gmail.py` locally once,
  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).
- **Public demo instance**: synthetic data only (D8), `INSTANCE_MODE=demo`, write
  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.
- **Private instance**: keep both servers on localhost or behind IAM; Gmail OAuth
  unchanged.

Local: two processes (backend :8000, frontend :3000 — see Quickstart). Without env
vars the backend still starts the keyless in-memory demo.

- **Frontend → Vercel**: project with root directory `web/`, env `BACKEND_URL` set to
  the backend URL, optional `APP_TIME_ZONE`. Hobby plan is free for personal use.
- **Backend → any long-running host** (it is a Python service — Vercel serverless
  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |
  Env vars: `DATABASE_URL`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`OR_API_KEY`/`ZAI_API_KEY`,
  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).
- **Gmail token on a deployed backend**: run `scripts/auth_gmail.py` locally once,
  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).
- **Public demo instance**: synthetic data only (D8), `INSTANCE_MODE=demo`, write
  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.
- **Private instance**: keep both servers on localhost or behind IAM; Gmail OAuth
  unchanged.

Local: two processes (backend :8000, frontend :3000 — see Quickstart). Without env

  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |

  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).
- **Gmail token on a deployed backend**: run `scripts/auth_gmail.py` locally once,
  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).

  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.

  unchanged.

vars the backend still starts the keyless in-memory demo.

- **Frontend → Vercel**: project with root directory `web/`, env `BACKEND_URL` set to
  the backend URL, optional `APP_TIME_ZONE`. Hobby plan is free for personal use.
- **Backend → any long-running host** (it is a Python service — Vercel serverless
  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |
  Env vars: `DATABASE_URL`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`OR_API_KEY`/`ZAI_API_KEY`,
  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).
- **Gmail token on a deployed backend**: run `scripts/auth_gmail.py` locally once,
  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).
- **Public demo instance**: synthetic data only (D8), `INSTANCE_MODE=demo`, write
  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.
- **Private instance**: keep both servers on localhost or behind IAM; Gmail OAuth
  unchanged.

Local: two processes (backend :8000, frontend :3000 — see Quickstart). Without env
vars the backend still starts the keyless in-memory demo.

- **Frontend → Vercel**: project with root directory `web/`, env `BACKEND_URL` set to
  the backend URL, optional `APP_TIME_ZONE`. Hobby plan is free for personal use.
- **Backend → any long-running host** (it is a Python service — Vercel serverless
  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |
  Env vars: `DATABASE_URL`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`OR_API_KEY`/`ZAI_API_KEY`,
  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).
- **Gmail token on a deployed backend**: run `scripts/auth_gmail.py` locally once,
  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).
- **Public demo instance**: synthetic data only (D8), `INSTANCE_MODE=demo`, write
  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.
- **Private instance**: keep both servers on localhost or behind IAM; Gmail OAuth
  unchanged.

Local: two processes (backend :8000, frontend :3000 — see Quickstart). Without env
vars the backend still starts the keyless in-memory demo.

- **Frontend → Vercel**: project with root directory `web/`, env `BACKEND_URL` set to
  the backend URL, optional `APP_TIME_ZONE`. Hobby plan is free for personal use.
- **Backend → any long-running host** (it is a Python service — Vercel serverless
  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |

  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).
- **Gmail token on a deployed backend**: run `scripts/auth_gmail.py` locally once,
  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).

  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.
- **Private instance**: keep both servers on localhost or behind IAM; Gmail OAuth
  unchanged.

Local: two processes (backend :8000, frontend :3000 — see Quickstart). Without env
vars the backend still starts the keyless in-memory demo.

- **Frontend → Vercel**: project with root directory `web/`, env `BACKEND_URL` set to
  the backend URL, optional `APP_TIME_ZONE`. Hobby plan is free for personal use.
- **Backend → any long-running host** (it is a Python service — Vercel serverless
  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |
  Env vars: `DATABASE_URL`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`OR_API_KEY`/`ZAI_API_KEY`,
  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).
- **Gmail token on a deployed backend**: run `scripts/auth_gmail.py` locally once,
  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).
- **Public demo instance**: synthetic data only (D8), `INSTANCE_MODE=demo`, write
  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.
- **Private instance**: keep both servers on localhost or behind IAM; Gmail OAuth
  unchanged.

Local: two processes (backend :8000, frontend :3000 — see Quickstart). Without env
vars the backend still starts the keyless in-memory demo.

- **Frontend → Vercel**: project with root directory `web/`, env `BACKEND_URL` set to
  the backend URL, optional `APP_TIME_ZONE`. Hobby plan is free for personal use.
- **Backend → any long-running host** (it is a Python service — Vercel serverless
  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |

  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).

  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).

  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.
- **Private instance**: keep both servers on localhost or behind IAM; Gmail OAuth
  unchanged.

- **Frontend → Vercel**: project with root directory `web/`, env `BACKEND_URL` set to
  the backend URL, optional `APP_TIME_ZONE`. Hobby plan is free for personal use.
- **Backend → any long-running host** (it is a Python service — Vercel serverless
  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |
  Env vars: `DATABASE_URL`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`OR_API_KEY`/`ZAI_API_KEY`,
  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).
- **Gmail token on a deployed backend**: run `scripts/auth_gmail.py` locally once,
  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).
- **Public demo instance**: synthetic data only (D8), `INSTANCE_MODE=demo`, write
  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.
- **Private instance**: keep both servers on localhost or behind IAM; Gmail OAuth
  unchanged.

- **Frontend → Vercel**: project with root directory `web/`, env `BACKEND_URL` set to
  the backend URL, optional `APP_TIME_ZONE`. Hobby plan is free for personal use.
- **Backend → any long-running host** (it is a Python service — Vercel serverless
  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |
  Env vars: `DATABASE_URL`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`OR_API_KEY`/`ZAI_API_KEY`,
  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).
- **Gmail token on a deployed backend**: run `scripts/auth_gmail.py` locally once,
  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).
- **Public demo instance**: synthetic data only (D8), `INSTANCE_MODE=demo`, write
  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.
- **Private instance**: keep both servers on localhost or behind IAM; Gmail OAuth
  unchanged.

Local: two processes (backend :8000, frontend :3000 — see Quickstart). Without env
vars the backend still starts the keyless in-memory demo.

- **Frontend → Vercel**: project with root directory `web/`, env `BACKEND_URL` set to
  the backend URL, optional `APP_TIME_ZONE`. Hobby plan is free for personal use.
- **Backend → any long-running host** (it is a Python service — Vercel serverless
  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |
  Env vars: `DATABASE_URL`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`OR_API_KEY`/`ZAI_API_KEY`,
  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).
- **Gmail token on a deployed backend**: run `scripts/auth_gmail.py` locally once,
  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).

  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.
- **Private instance**: keep both servers on localhost or behind IAM; Gmail OAuth
  unchanged.

Local: two processes (backend :8000, frontend :3000 — see Quickstart). Without env
vars the backend still starts the keyless in-memory demo.

- **Frontend → Vercel**: project with root directory `web/`, env `BACKEND_URL` set to
  the backend URL, optional `APP_TIME_ZONE`. Hobby plan is free for personal use.
- **Backend → any long-running host** (it is a Python service — Vercel serverless
  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |
  Env vars: `DATABASE_URL`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`OR_API_KEY`/`ZAI_API_KEY`,
  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).
- **Gmail token on a deployed backend**: run `scripts/auth_gmail.py` locally once,
  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).
- **Public demo instance**: synthetic data only (D8), `INSTANCE_MODE=demo`, write
  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.
- **Private instance**: keep both servers on localhost or behind IAM; Gmail OAuth
  unchanged.

Local: two processes (backend :8000, frontend :3000 — see Quickstart). Without env
vars the backend still starts the keyless in-memory demo.

- **Frontend → Vercel**: project with root directory `web/`, env `BACKEND_URL` set to
  the backend URL, optional `APP_TIME_ZONE`. Hobby plan is free for personal use.
- **Backend → any long-running host** (it is a Python service — Vercel serverless
  cannot host it):
  | Host | How | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Render | New Web Service from the repo, runtime Docker, env vars below | free tier sleeps after ~15 min (slow first sync) |
  | Railway | Deploy from repo (Docker), env vars below | simplest, usage-based |
  | Cloud Run | `gcloud run deploy` from the Dockerfile | plan's choice; IAM-gated ingress so only Next.js reaches it |
  Env vars: `DATABASE_URL`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`OR_API_KEY`/`ZAI_API_KEY`,
  `INSTANCE_MODE=private`, and Gmail (below).
- **Gmail token on a deployed backend**: run `scripts/auth_gmail.py` locally once,
  then paste the file contents into the `GMAIL_TOKEN_JSON` env var (the filesystem
  on hosts is ephemeral).
- **Public demo instance**: synthetic data only (D8), `INSTANCE_MODE=demo`, write
  tools stubbed, chat capped at 100 turns/day. Put a spend limit at the provider.
- **Private instance**: keep both servers on localhost or behind IAM; Gmail OAuth
  unchanged.
